column20: THE POSITIVE BATTERY CABLE MAY CHAFE AGAINST THE BRACKET AND SHORT TO THE BODY STRUCTURE.
column21: A SHORT CIRCUIT INCREASES THE RISK OF A FIRE WHILE THE VEHICLE IS PARKED OR DRIVING.
column22: DEALERS WILL INSPECT AND REROUTE THE CABLE AND FIT A PROTECTIVE SLEEVE FREE OF CHARGE.
column23: OWNERS MAY CONTACT THE MANUFACTURER CUSTOMER SERVICE LINE.

column20: THE FUEL PUMP IMPELLER MAY DEFORM AND BIND INSIDE THE PUMP HOUSING.
column21: AN ENGINE STALL WITHOUT WARNING INCREASES THE RISK OF A CRASH.
column22: DEALERS WILL REPLACE THE FUEL PUMP MODULE FREE OF CHARGE.

column20: THE DRIVER FRONTAL AIR BAG INFLATOR MAY RUPTURE ON DEPLOYMENT.
column21: METAL FRAGMENTS COULD STRIKE OCCUPANTS AND CAUSE SERIOUS INJURY OR DEATH.
column22: DEALERS WILL REPLACE THE DRIVER AIR BAG MODULE FREE OF CHARGE.
column23: THIS CAMPAIGN SUPERSEDES AN EARLIER SERVICE ACTION.

column20: THE BRAKE MASTER CYLINDER SEAL MAY ALLOW INTERNAL FLUID BYPASS.
column21: REDUCED BRAKING PERFORMANCE INCREASES THE RISK OF A CRASH.
column22: DEALERS WILL REPLACE THE MASTER CYLINDER FREE OF CHARGE.

column20: INTERNAL CELL DEFECTS IN THE HIGH VOLTAGE BATTERY MAY LEAD TO A THERMAL EVENT.
column21: A BATTERY FIRE MAY OCCUR WHILE PARKED OR CHARGING AND INCREASES THE RISK OF INJURY.
column22: DEALERS WILL UPDATE THE BATTERY MANAGEMENT SOFTWARE AND REPLACE AFFECTED MODULES.
column23: OWNERS ARE ADVISED TO PARK OUTSIDE AND AWAY FROM STRUCTURES UNTIL THE REMEDY IS COMPLETE.

column20: THE LOW BEAM HEADLAMP MODULE MAY OVERHEAT AND DIM BELOW THE REQUIRED OUTPUT.
column21: REDUCED FORWARD ILLUMINATION INCREASES THE RISK OF A CRASH AT NIGHT.
column22: DEALERS WILL REPLACE BOTH HEADLAMP MODULES FREE OF CHARGE.

column20: CERTAIN TYRES MAY EXPERIENCE TREAD BELT SEPARATION AFTER PROLONGED HIGHWAY USE.
column21: A SUDDEN LOSS OF INFLATION PRESSURE INCREASES THE RISK OF A CRASH.
column22: DEALERS WILL REPLACE THE AFFECTED TYRES FREE OF CHARGE.

column20: THE HARNESS BUCKLE MAY RELEASE UNDER LOAD BELOW THE REQUIRED THRESHOLD.
column21: A CHILD MAY NOT BE PROPERLY RESTRAINED IN A CRASH WHICH INCREASES THE RISK OF INJURY.
column22: THE MANUFACTURER WILL SEND A REPLACEMENT BUCKLE ASSEMBLY WITH FITTING INSTRUCTIONS.

column20: THE OUTER TIE ROD END MAY HAVE BEEN ASSEMBLED WITHOUT THE RETAINING CLIP.
column21: A LOSS OF STEERING CONTROL INCREASES THE RISK OF A CRASH.
column22: DEALERS WILL INSPECT AND REPLACE THE TIE ROD ENDS AS REQUIRED FREE OF CHARGE.
column23: VEHICLES SHOULD NOT BE DRIVEN UNTIL THE INSPECTION IS COMPLETE.

column20: THE REAR VISIBILITY CAMERA MAY DISPLAY A FROZEN OR BLANK IMAGE WHEN REVERSE IS SELECTED.
column21: A DRIVER WITHOUT A REAR VIEW HAS A REDUCED FIELD OF VIEW WHICH INCREASES THE RISK OF A CRASH.
column22: DEALERS WILL REPROGRAM THE INFOTAINMENT CONTROL MODULE FREE OF CHARGE.
